status_rule: Scripts refuse to train, preprocess or infer until status is 'locked_before_a2_training' and this file is committed. Change only the status field when locking.

parent_protocol.unchanged: H1-H3, the parent analysis report and the A1 report are not changed, re-tested or re-interpreted

purpose.A_normalisation_scope: Test whether the E6 deficit reflects z-scoring itself or its full-record scope (about 23 h, mostly daytime, in Sleep-EDF versus the in-bed period in SHHS1), by retraining E6 with scope-matched statistics.
purpose.B_training_seeds: Characterise between-seed variability of E3 and E4 with five training seeds instead of two.
purpose.C_ensemble_asymmetry: Quantify how much the ten-model ensemble used on SHHS1 changes scores relative to single fold models, the unit used on Sleep-EDF.
purpose.D_em_sample_size: Test whether the collapse of EM prior correction is due to estimating the prior from five recordings or to the label-shift assumption failing under feature shift.
purpose.E_training_cost: Decompose the training-time difference between E0 and the ResNet-1D-TCN pipelines into number of optimiser steps and time per step.
purpose.text_only: The ADAST backbone difference and the absence of a shared EEG derivation are handled in the manuscript text; no experiment is added for them.

status_of_holdout: Holdout labels were used by the parent analysis and by A1. A2 is post-confirmatory and descriptive. No arm, seed, window length, subset size or threshold below depends on holdout results; all are fixed before any A2 training.

training.source: Sleep-EDF SC, the locked ten-fold subject split data/splits/sleepedf_sc_10fold_seed42_v2.json, validation fold = next fold
training.runner: the current scripts/run_experiment.py code path (src/sleeptcn/experiment.run_experiment) with the unchanged configs/experiments_v2.json (SHA-256 1d812bbf...); this runner was refactored after the seed-123 campaign (runner hash 12245ec0... at commit 88a5d2c), so its equivalence is checked first

reproduction_check.run: E4, fold 0, seed 123, trained with the A2 runner on the rented GPU before any A2 run, under runs/a2/full/REPRO_E4/fold_00/seed_123
reproduction_check.reference: archived seed-123 E4 fold-0 run at commit 8af1d12 (validation metrics, completed epochs and best epoch of each stage)
reproduction_check.outcome: reported as identical or, if not, the size of the difference in validation macro-F1 and best epoch; A2 proceeds either way and the result is disclosed, because GPU and library versions also differ from the original campaign

E6W.normalisation: band-pass 0.5-30 Hz, clip +-800 uV, z-score with mean and standard deviation of the filtered, clipped signal inside the evaluation window (30 min before the first to 30 min after the last N1/N2/N3/REM epoch)
E6W.note: diagnostic: the window bounds use reference labels, exactly as the evaluation window itself does; not a deployable rule

E6R.normalisation: band-pass 0.5-30 Hz, clip +-800 uV, centred moving-window z-score over 90 min (truncated at record edges), standard-deviation floor 1 uV
E6R.note: label-free; 90 min is about one sleep cycle, so each window normally contains both light and deep sleep

training.seed_note: 2025 is the third confirmatory training seed already listed in configs/experiments_v2.json; 2027 and 2029 are fixed here. With seeds 42 and 123 this gives five seeds for E3 and E4.
training.order: E6W s42, E6R s42, E6W s123, E6R s123, then E3/E4 by seed; within a seed all ten folds
training.parallelism: several training processes may share one GPU; each run is independent and deterministic settings are unchanged
training.sleep_edf_test: after every A2 run has completed validation-only training and passed run validation, the locked Sleep-EDF test folds are evaluated once with the pre-locked best checkpoints (out-of-fold predictions)

shhs.cohort: the 500 holdout participants of the parent analysis
shhs.new_variant_preprocessing: same EDF/XML inputs, resampling, label mapping and evaluation window as the parent manifest; written to a separate A2 manifest
shhs.existing_variants: E3 and E4 arms reuse the hash-verified filtered_v2 and bandpass_v2 holdout inputs of the parent manifest
shhs.ensembling: arithmetic mean of the ten fold softmax probabilities (float64 accumulator, float32 storage), argmax; every fold artifact is kept
shhs.device: CPU, or CUDA if the A2 code reproduces stored CPU fold probabilities of E4_s42 for two records at folds 0 and 9 within 1e-5 with identical argmax

analyses.hypothesis_tests: none; all A2 results are descriptive

A_normalisation_scope.input_scale: median and IQR of the within-window standard deviation of the E6, E6W and E6R inputs on Sleep-EDF and on the holdout sample
A_normalisation_scope.sleep_edf: pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 of E6W and E6R against E3, E4 and E6 at the same seed
A_normalisation_scope.interpretation_rule: The manuscript keeps the statement that preserving calibrated amplitude transferred better than z-scoring only if E4 - E6W and E4 - E6R both have intervals above zero at both seeds. Otherwise the statement is restricted to full-record z-scoring as implemented, and the scope-matched result is reported.

B_training_seeds.metrics: holdout subject-mean macro-F1 and Sleep-EDF pooled macro-F1 per seed; mean, standard deviation and range over seeds; all ten pairwise between-seed differences per configuration; E4 - E3 at each seed with its interval
B_training_seeds.interpretation_rule: The manuscript replaces the two-seed range of between-seed differences with the five-seed summary and compares it descriptively with the H1-H3 estimates; no new test is made.

C_ensemble_asymmetry.arms: all parent zero-shot holdout arms (E0, E2, E3, E4, E6 at seeds 42 and 123) and all A2 arms
C_ensemble_asymmetry.metrics: for each fold model alone: subject-mean macro-F1, N3 recall, N3->N2 rate; mean and range over the ten fold models; ensemble minus mean single-model value with a paired interval

D_em_sample_size.probabilities: stored holdout ensemble probabilities, no temperature scaling
D_em_sample_size.source_prior: Sleep-EDF scored-epoch class frequencies of the 78 subjects (label counts only)
D_em_sample_size.em: estimate_target_prior in src/sleeptcn/calibration.py (tolerance 1e-8, at most 1000 iterations, floor 1e-12)

prior_data.subsets: unlabelled epochs of n randomly drawn holdout recordings, n in [5, 20, 100], 1000 draws each (generator seed 2044)
prior_data.all: unlabelled epochs of all 500 holdout recordings
prior_data.per_record: each recording's own unlabelled epochs, applied to that recording only

D_em_sample_size.outcomes: estimated N3 prior against the observed holdout N3 share; after prior adjustment of all 500 recordings: N3 recall, N3 predictions, subject-mean macro-F1
D_em_sample_size.interpretation_rule: If the prior estimated from all 500 recordings still lies far below the observed N3 share and suppresses N3 predictions, the collapse is attributed to the label-shift assumption failing, not to the five-recording sample.

E_training_cost.steps: completed epochs and optimiser steps of every stage of the archived seed-123 campaign, read from its checkpoints (commit 8af1d12)
E_training_cost.step_time: median forward+backward+optimiser time per step on the rented V100 for SleepCNN (batch 64), ResNet-1D (batch 64), BiLSTM (batch 4 sequences) and TCN (batch 8 sequences) with synthetic inputs, 20 warm-up and 200 timed steps, run alone on the GPU
E_training_cost.outcome: steps x time per step per stage, compared with the observed wall-clock time of each configuration
